key_insight: LEAP combines a domain-specialized LLM with active learning to prioritize perovskite precursor additives more intelligently than trial-and-error screening.
engineering_relevance: The framework can speed up additive selection for perovskite solar cells by using literature-grounded mechanistic descriptors and uncertainty-aware optimization to reduce experimental search cost.
method: Train an LLM on perovskite additive literature to extract mechanism-relevant knowledge.
Convert candidate molecules into interpretable descriptors for downstream ranking.
Use Bayesian optimization plus expert feasibility review to iteratively prioritize additives in closed loop.
evidence_signal: On unseen literature, the domain-specialized model outperformed general-purpose models, and the proof-of-concept screening across three rounds yielded average PCEs of 20.13% and 20.87% for later-round treated devices versus 19.25% for control, with a champion PCE of 21.32%.
watch_item: The reported gains come from a proof-of-concept study with expert-in-the-loop filtering, so broader generalization and automation-level robustness still need validation.
paper_title: LEAP: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
